source: The moment the word left his mouth the rune under his hands lit up and starting from him the other runes also lit up in sequence, bathing the giant chamber in pale blue light that seemed to be fighting for dominance with the white light streaked with darkness.
target: Momento quo verbum ex ore eius emicuit, runa sub manibus eius accensa est, et ab eo reliquae runae quoque ordine fulserunt, ingentem cameram lumine pallidi caerulei perfusam, quae videbatur cum albo lumine, obscuritate tincto, dominari contendere.

source: While the monster’s eyes shined with unnatural insight, as the controlling intelligence behind the miasma realized (at least partially) what was happening, it roared, but by the time it began to do something the blue light emitted by Sam’s runes surrounded it and the rune circle was activated.
target: Dum oculi monstri insolita perspicacia fulgebant, dum intelligentia regens post miasma saltem partim id quod accidere videbatur intellexit, rugivit; sed cum aliquid agere coepisset, lumen caeruleum a runis Sam emisso eum circumdedit et circulus runarum activatus est.

source: Sam watched as the blue light shining from the runes flashed once, twice, then thrice.
target: Sam aspexit dum lumen caeruleum ex runis semel, bis, deinde ter fulserit.

source: The moment the last flash was over, the intelligence from the eyes of the golem vanished, replaced by the more familiar emptiness he had seen in the other golems.
target: Momento quo ultima micatio finita est, intelligentia ex oculis golem effugit, substituta inania notiore quam in aliis golemis vidisset.

source: But the changes didn’t stop there.
target: Sed mutationes hic non desierunt.

source: The runes flashed once again, sending out a pulse of pale blue light parallel to the ground, sweeping along it inside the rune circle until it reached the golem that was still processing what happened to it.
target: Runae iterum fulserunt, pulsum lucis pallide caeruleae terræ parallelam emiantes, eam intra circulum runarum traiecunt, usque ad golem, qui rem suam adhuc elaborabat.

source: The runes flashed a final time before finally going out, however, the light they released began to pool under the golem, and then began to rise upwards like some kind of scanning from an old sci‑fi movie.
target: Runae ultimo tempore fulserunt antequam tandem exstiterunt; sed lumen, quod emitterunt, coepit sub golem congregari et deinde ascendere, quasi modus perscrutandi ex antiqua pellicula scientiae fictae.

source: The parts that the flat plane of light touched lost their liquid state and, as if drying out insanely fast, turned into a crystallized material akin to obsidian, endlessly reflecting and refracting the white light originating from the stone torches.
target: Partes quas planum lucis attigit, statum liquidum amisit et, quasi celeriter exsiccatae, in materiam crystallizatam similem obsidianae conversae sunt, quae sine fine lumen album a lapide torcia oriens reflexum atque refractum exhibebat.

source: Sam watched fascinated as the golem was struck motionless and slowly but surely transformed from a sludge‑like consistency into what was basically the same material but all the water (or whatever the miasma considered water) sucked out.
target: Sam admiratus aspexit dum golem immobilis caderet et paulatim sed certissime ex consistance limosi in materiam eandem converteretur, cum omnis aqua (aut quidquid miasma aquam appellabat) evanuerit.

source: Effectively turning the sludge type of golem into a crystal type of golem.
target: Effecit itaque ut golem limosus in golem crystallinum converteretur.

source: The moment the pale blue plane of magic reached the top of the head of the golem, it stayed there for a fleeting moment and then simply winked out of existence, leaving behind a golem staring directly at Sam.
target: Momento quo planum magiae pallide caeruleum apicem capitis golem attigit, ibi instante mansit atque deinde prorsus exsistentiam evanuit, relinquens post se golem directē ad Sam spectantem.

source: He grinned, then readied both his sword and magic, because while the sludge golem was rather hard to defeat with physical attacks, a crystal golem was an entirely different story.
target: Risum sublatus est, tum gladium et magiam paravit, quoniam dum golem limosus corporeis ictibus difficile superari videbatur, golem crystallinus prorsus alia erat.

source: Especially with the small white light writhing in the middle of its chest making it look as if the body of the golem was holding the night sky thanks to the refraction.
target: Praesertim cum parvum lumen album in medio pectoris ejus versaretur, ita ut videbatur corpus golem caelum nocturnum tenere, gratia refracti luminis.

source: Obviously, the controlling intelligence was gone, as the golem simply raised its hands and pointed at Sam.
target: Sane, intelligentia regens evanuerat, quippe quod golem simpliciter manus levavit et ad Sam indicavit.

source: He reflexively stepped aside, but to both of their surprise, nothing came from the hands.
target: Reflexive se recedens, sed ad utrorumque admirationem, ex manibus nihil emersit.

source: Sam watched as the golem processed and then tried it a few times before whatever programming left behind by its controller kicked in and gave up on raining deathly projectiles on Sam and simply raised its hands and charged at him.
target: Sam aspexit dum golem rem processit et aliquoties conatus est, antequam quidquid programmatum ab eius regente relictum in effectum venerit et in Sam proiectoria mortifera destinaverit, simpliciter manus levavit et in eum impetum fecit.

source: Sam, still grinning thanks to his plan coming to fruition, simply dodged the strike by jumping to the side.
target: Sam, adhuc risu perfusus ob consilium suum confectum, ictum eludere simulante ad latus salire.

source: “Wind Flurry!”
target: «Turbo Ventorum!»

source: The wind blades launched from his sword raced directly at the center of the chest of the golem, but it raised its hands just in time.
target: Laminae venti a gladio ejus emissae directe in centrum pectoris golem contendebant, sed golem manus justo tempore levavit.

source: Though it damaged the arms, it was still a bother that it missed.
target: Quamvis bracchia laesit, tamen molestum erat quod ictum non pervenisset.

source: Sam clicked his tongue but still continued to dodge the very linear charges of the golem.
target: Sam linguam strinxit, sed tamen impetus lineares golem eludere pergebat.

source: Because while it was smart (and fast) enough to protect its core, it wasn’t smart enough to figure out how to fight with its new body without the intelligence that his rune circle stripped from it.
target: Nam quamquam callidum (et velox) erat ad cor suum protegendum, non satis sapiens erat ut pugnandi rationem cum novo corpore sine illa intelligentia, quam circulus runarum ei abstulit, inveniret.

source: So, it defaulted to the old charge and smash attack pattern.
target: Ergo ad vetus impetum et concussum modum defuit.

source: Which was pretty easy to circumvent…
target: Quod omnino facile circumvenire videbatur…

source: For a hot minute, the only thing that could be heard in the chamber were Sam’s echoing cries of Wind Flurry (while he internally lamented his lack of attack spells and skills) and the sound of the crystalline golem rumbling along the ground and smashing uselessly into the ground as Sam would inevitably dodge their very linear attack.
target: Per brevem momentum, sola in camera audiri potebantur Sam vociferationes "Turbo Ventorum" resonantes (dum internis lamentationibus de defectu incantationum et artium pugnandi affectus erat) atque sonus golem crystallini, qui per terram fremebat et ineptim in terram contundebat, dum Sam inevitabiliter eorum linearem impetum eludebat.

source: Then the sound of a crack could be heard.
target: Tum sonus crepitus audiri potuit.

source: Then another and another, until Sam was listening with a small smile to crystal chunks falling to the ground and shattering into even smaller parts as he watched the left hand of the golem practically fall apart.
target: Tum iterum et iterum, donec Sam cum parvo risu auscultabat fragmenta crystallina in terram cadentia et in particulas minora dissoluentia, dum sinistram manum golem paene dissolvi observebat.

source: First little pieces from the part that Sam targeted with his every cast, then bigger pieces began to fall until the golem was standing there with only a small chunk of crystalline material jutting out of its shoulder.
target: Primum parva fragmenta ex parte quam Sam omni incantatione petivit, deinde maiora cadere coeperunt, donec golem stabat ibi, cum ex humero eius tantum parvum fragmentum materiae crystallinae eminens esset.

source: Sam’s smile turned vicious, and he exclaimed.
target: Risus Sam malitiosis factus est, ac exclamavit.

source: “Shadow Burst!”
target: «Eruptio Umbrarum!»

source: Thanks to his increase in speed, he managed to get around the golem while it was trying to process the loss of one of its arms and made sure to use all three seconds of increased speed that the skill granted him.
target: Gratia crescentis celeritatis, circum golem se circumvenire potuit, dum illud damnum unius brachii perpendere conabatur, atque curavit ut omnes tres secundae celeritatis a peritia concessae adhiberentur.

source: He let go of a storm of Wind Blades, mixed with Wind Flurrys as well as Mana Slashes followed by Double Mana Slashes, all aimed at approximately the same spot.
target: Emisit turbam laminarum venti, mixtam cum “Turbo Ventorum” atque ictibus mana, deinde duplici ictu mana, omnes ad fere eundem locum destinatos.

source: As the skill ended and the golem started turning, there was a nice spot on the surprisingly smooth back of the golem, exactly on top where the light seemed to be housed in its body.
target: Cum peritia finem attigit et golem verti coepit, apparuit locus pulcher in tergo golem, prorsus in summitate, ubi lumen in eius corpore degere videbatur.

source: The spot was circular, with cracks radiating everywhere.
target: Locus circularis erat, fissuris ubique radiantibus.

source: He took a few steps backwards, waiting for the golem to take a few steps, ramping up for another pointless charge, then without taking his eyes off his enemy, exclaimed.
target: Aliquot gradus retrocedens, exspectavit ut golem gradus paucos moveret ad alium impetum inutilis parandum, deinde hosti oculos non avertens, exclamavit.

source: “Lucky, once more!”
target: «Lucky, iterum!»

source: The wolf vanished from his shadow, and once again reappeared behind the golem.
target: Lupus ex umbra sua evanuit et iterum post golem apparuit.

source: At the same moment, the golem began to charge and Lucky launched itself at the back of the golem.
target: Eodem tempore, golem impetum facere coepit atque Lucky se ad tergum golem iactavit.

source: The end result was the golem face‑planting with Lucky looking at it wearing a proud look on his face.
target: Exitus fuit ut golem faciem in terram demergeret, dum Lucky eum spectans vultu superbo apparebat.

source: Sam just ran over, grabbed the hilt of his sword with both hands, and as the golem was attempting to stand up with one hand, channeled almost all of his mana into it and with an incoherent yell slammed it down at the spot he had weakened.
target: Sam cucurrit, manubrium gladii utrisque manibus arripuit, et dum golem una manu surgere conabatur, fere omnem vim magicam in eum infudit, inepto clamore eum in loco, quem debilitaverat, deiecit.

source: The golem spasmed a little, then fell motionless, leaving the chamber once again silent.
target: Golem paulo spasit, deinde immotus cecidit, relinquens cameram iterum silentem.

source: And as the golem lay there, Sam watched as the pinpricks of light in its obsidian‑like body went out and with them the torches died down a little, only to come back to life, blazing even stronger, however, they were lacking the black streaks that tainted them previously.
target: Et dum golem ibi iacebat, Sam aspexit quomodo parva puncta lucis in eius corpore, quod obsidiana simile videbatur, extinguebantur, et cum eis torcia aliquantulum exstinguebantur, ut rursus in vitam redire inciperent, fulgentes etiam magis, attamen carentes lineis nigris quae prius eos maculaverant.

source: The wall of white fire that locked him into the room also vanished.
target: Murus ignis albi qui eum in camera claudebat, quoque evanuit.

source: Sam twisted the sword a little, making sure that the monster was dead, then pulled it out, scoffed at the broken tip, and threw it away.
target: Sam gladium paululum quassavit, certus monstrum mortuum esse, deinde gladium extraxit, apicem fractum irridens, et proiecit eum.

source: The low‑quality sword landed with a clang that coincided with the notification sound going off in his head.
target: Gladius ignobilis clangore cecidit, quod cum sono notificationis in mente eius conveniebat.

source: [Congratulations, you defeated the Boss of the Ironwood Glade Ruins!]
target: [Gratulamur, Magistrum Ruinarum Gladis Ironwood superavisti!]

source: The monster in front of him simply collapsed into itself, turning into dust in a few moments, leaving behind a softly glowing white ball.
target: Monstrum coram eo simpliciter in se collapsum est, paucos momentis in pulverem conversum, relinquens post se globulum album leniter fulgentem.

source: Nodding at the confirmation that he was done, he leaned down and softly lifted the glowing ball of light with his palm.
target: Nutans ad confirmationem sui facti, inclinavit se et globulum lucis fulgentis leniter in palma sustulit.

source: He had to shut down his Mage Sight, as the ball of light without the obscuring effect of the dark miasma almost blinded him with its intensity.
target: Oportuit eum "visum magicarum" rescindere, nam globus lucis sine effectu obscuranti miasma fere eum caecaverat intensitate sua.

source: He spent a few moments observing it with his Mana Sense, but the only feeling he got was that it was filled with an overwhelming amount of life energy.
target: Paucis momentis eam cum sensu mana observavit, sed sola sensatio quae ei attigit fuit, eam copia energiae vitae impleri.

source: ‘Probably some kind of energy used to maintain the trees…’
target: ‘Forsitan quaedam energia ad arbores conservandas usurpata…’

source: Looking at the ball of light in his palm and the giant ball of rock cradled by the stone roots that lost almost all of its shine, now that the miasma golem was defeated, Sam knew what he had to do.
target: Observans globulum lucis in palma eius et magnum globum saxi, radicibus lapideis foventem qui fere totum splendorem amisit, nunc quod miasma golem superatum erat, Sam intellexit quid agendum haberet.

source: So, he simply walked up to it and pressed the ball of light into it.
target: Ergo, se appropinquavit et globulum lucis in eum immisit.

source: Technically, he could have stored the ball of life energy away for later use, but that would have invalidated his quest and more than likely would have made him a lot of enemies…
target: Technice, globulum energiae vitae ad usum futurum condere potuisset, sed id expeditionem eius inficeret et verisimiliter multos inimicos ei attulisset…

source: The moment the light sunk into the giant rock, it began to spin with ever‑increasing speed while the light seemed to seep out of the cracks that before were filled with miasma.
target: Momento quo lumen in magnum saxum immittebat, incepit celeritate crescenti gyrari, dum lumen ex fissuris, quondam miasma replentibus, effluere videbatur.

source: This continued until he was watching a rapidly spinning rock in the middle of the room shining with the same light he held in his hands, but somehow more.
target: Hoc perstitit, donec spectabat saxum in media camera celeriter gyrantem, fulgentem eodem lumine quem in manibus tenebat, sed aliquantum amplius.

source: And there was a pleasant feeling radiating from it.
target: Et ex eo emanabat sensus amoenus.

source: Sam felt at peace…
target: Sam se pacatum sensit…

source: “Oh, that is why it was sooo familiar!”
target: «O, ideo tam nota erat!»

source: Sam would forever deny that he yelped in surprise and jumped into the air as a voice sounded next to him.
target: Sam in aeternum negasset se in stupore exclamavisse atque in aethera salisse, cum vox prope eum audiebatur.

source: Looking down at the origin of the voice, he saw to his consternation, the giant cricket that was supposed to be staying outside.
target: Depiciens oculos ad originem vocis, vidit ad suam consternationem ingentem gryllam, quae foris manere debebat.

source: The cricket turned towards him with her entire body and had the gall to smirk at him.
target: Grylla se totum corpore ad eum convertit et ausa est ei subridere.

source: Sam didn’t know how it worked on a cricket body…
target: Sam nesciebat quomodo hoc in corpore gryllae operaretur…

source: “I never said I’d stay outside, child of man.
target: By the way, excellent fight!”

source: After a few moments, Sam managed to grunt out a sentence.
target: Post paucos momenta, Sam verba exclamare potuit.

source: “Thank you?”
target: «Gratias?»

source: “You’re most welcome, young Sam!” came the chirpy reply, and the cricket turned back to staring at the glowing orb of life energy rotating in the middle of the room.
target: «Maxime tibi gratum est, iuven Sam!» inquit laete, et grylla iterum ad globum lucis vitae, qui in media camera gyrabat, spectare coepit.

source: Sam let the silence fill the room for a while as he gained control over his hammering heart, but in the end, he needed to know.
target: Sam silentium in camera aliquantulum praestare permisit, dum cor suum concitato moderabat, sed in fine scire cupiebat.

source: “Why is it so familiar, ma’am?”
target: «Cur ita nota est, domina?»

source: There was a moment as the cricket hummed, then with a poof of magic, turned back into her humanoid form, still standing next to Sam, and reaching out with her hand towards the rotating globe.
target: Momento graviter, grylla murmuravit, deinde, cum magica impetu, in formam humanam rediit, adhuc iuxta Sam stans, manum ad globum gyrantem tendens.

source: She seemed to almost caress the rock.
target: Videbatur paene saxum teneriter palpare.

source: “I was here when this place was made.
target: I was the guardian.

source: She paused and Sam had to fight hard not to roll his eyes at the very cliché development.
target: Illa pausavit, et Sam vehementer contendere debuit ne oculos suos volvere in hoc tam praesuppositum progressu.

source: “But something corrupted the link, something dark and evil.
target: But now that you removed it, it seems the connection is back, and with it, my memories, child of man.”

source: “I’m glad to hear” said Sam, not knowing what else to say.
target: «Gaudeo hoc audire,» inquit Sam, nesciens quid aliud dicere posset.

source: “You should be. If the darkness had been able to completely consume the life energy, then it would have spelled doom for the forest and the land beyond it.”
target: «Tu debes esse; si obscuritas totam vim vitae consumere potuisset, tunc fatum foret silvae et terrae ultra eam.»

source: “Makes sense.”
target: «Sane.»

source: “It does, doesn’t it?” came the whimsical reply as the humanoid cricket continued to caress the rock almost lovingly.
target: «Ita vero, nonne?» inquit iocositer, dum grylla humanoide saxum paene amore teneriter palpabat.

source: Sam glanced at the glowing rock and the humanoid monster that seemed to be almost out of it
target: Sam oculos ad saxum fulgentem et monstrum humanoidem, quod paene ex eo procedere videbatur, coniecit.

source: “Now what?”
target: «Nunc quid?»

source: The monster retrieved her hand from the glowing rock and turned towards him; her face set into a knowing smirk.
target: Monstra manum suam e saxo fulgente recepit et in eum conversum est; vultus eius, sapiens subridens, constitutus est.

source: “Now, child of man, you do me a favor and you can retrieve your prize and leave.”
target: «Nunc, fili hominis, mihi benefac et praemium tuum recipies, atque discedes.»

source: Sam simply raised an inquisitive eyebrow.
target: Sam simpliciter supercilium curiosum levavit.

source: “Up there is a crack where the miasma is seeping in,” she said, pointing upwards into the darkness of the ceiling of the chamber.
target: «In summo est fissura, unde miasma diffunditur,» inquit illa, digitum sursum trahens ad obscuritatem laquearii camerae.

source: “You fix that crack, and I’ll give you what you seek.”
target: «Fissuram illam repara, et dabitur tibi quod quaeris.»

source: “And what about the origin of the miasma?”
target: «Et quid de origine miasmatis?»

source: The answer he received didn’t surprise him much.
target: Responsio quam accepit eum parum miravit.

source: “Don’t worry, now that I’m awake and aware, I can express my displeasure to them about what constitutes as good neighborly behavior!”
target: «Noli timere, nunc quod evigilavi et conscius sum, possum eis exprimere indignationem meam de iis rebus, quae, ut puto, verum bonum vicinorum mores non constituunt!»

source: He couldn’t help but shudder at the tone, but he still couldn’t pity the fools that dabbled in things that resulted in things like the miasma that he had been fighting for the last few hours.
target: Non potuit non tremere ob tonum, sed etiam non potuit misereri stultos, qui in rebus versabantur quae ad miasma similia redibant, quas per horas pugnaverat.

source: Shaking his head, then nodded and headed for one of the sides of the chamber, while the giant humanoid cricket turned back to the glowing rock filled with life energy without a word with Lucky wandering next to her and sitting down and curiously staring at the same rock.
target: Caput concutens, deinde annuit et ad unum latus camerae properavit, dum ingens grylla humanoides ad globum lucis, vita energia implentem, sine verbo redeunavit, atque Lucky iuxta eam vagans sedebat et illud saxum mirabatur.

source: He walked up to the wall, placed his hand on it and cast Earth Wall, creating a foothold.
target: Accessit ad murum, manum in eum posuit et "Murum Terrae" effecit, firmamentum creans.

source: He tested it and, seeing as it took his body weight, he did a few times until he had a very neat but probably dangerous staircase leading up to the ceiling of the chamber.
target: Id probabilavit, et cum pondus corporis eius sustineret, id paucoties repetivit, donec habuit scalas ordinatas sed fortasse periculosas ad laquearium camerae accessum efficiendas.

source: A minute of climbing later he stood under the ceiling looking for the leak like some kind of fantasy contractor.
target: Post minuto ascensu, stetit sub laqueario quaerens effusum sicut aliquis conductarius phantasiarum.

source: ‘Well, an adventurer is a kinda contractor, so it works…’ he mused while searching.
target: ‘Ita, audax viator quasi conductarius est, ergo id operatur…’ meditatus est dum quaerebat.

source: “Ahh, there it is!”
target: «Ahh, ecce, hic est!»

source: After spotting, it took a little maneuvering before he stood under it, giving thanks that he wasn’t afraid of heights, and with a brief application of Earth Wall and a little extra and the crack in the stone ceiling was filled not just on the surface level but deeper inside.
target: Postquam id deprehendit, aliquantulum manœuvrationis necessariae factae sunt, antequam sub eo staret; gratias egit quod altitudines non timuerit, et cum brevi incantatione "Murum Terrae" et paulo addito, fissura in laqueario saxo non solum superne, sed etiam interno implenda fuit.

source: While he was up there, Sam used his Mana Sense to probe in the direction the miasma seemed to be coming from, and almost fell from recoil from touching the dark mana that seemed to permeate the rock.
target: Dum ibi stetit, Sam sensu mana usus est ad indagandum quo miasma videbatur provenire, et paene cecidit ex repugnatione quod tecta obscura mana, quae saxum pervadere videbatur, attigit.

source: ‘That’s some baaad juju…’
target: ‘Haec est vere mala magia…’

source: Following that, he quickly returned to the ground, canceling the Earth Walls he had created.
target: Post hoc celeriter ad terram rediit, Murum Terrae, quod creaverat, revocans.

source: Soon, he was once again standing next to the guardian and Lucky, who were staring at the rotating orb, transfixed.
target: Statim, iterum stetit iuxta custodem et Lucky, qui globum rotientem contemplabant, attoniti.

source: He cleared his throat gently, causing his wolf companion to fall over in surprise and the giant cricket to turn towards him.
target: Leniter guttur emisit, efficens ut comes lupus eius ex admiratione caderet et ingens grylla ad eum converteretur.

source: “It’s done.”
target: «Peractum est.»

source: “I know. Here is your reward.”
target: «Scio. Ecce praemium tuum.»

source: A simple chalice appeared in his hand, made from, to his not‑surprise, ironwood with filigree made from iron.
target: Calix simplex in manu eius apparuit, ex ligno ferreo factus (ut non miraretur), ornatus filigranis ex ferro.

source: “Thank you for your help, child of man.
target: But it is time for you to leave, and for me to chastise a few people…”

source: Sam was about to answer, but between two blinks, he found himself standing back in the clearing from where he entered the ruins.
target: Sam iam respondi vellebat, sed inter duas palpebras se invenit rursus in prato, unde ruinas intraverat, stantem.

source: The archway he used was conspicuously missing, and he could hear in the far distance screams of despair.
target: Arcus quem usus erat manifeste defuit, atque in longinquo clamores desperationis audiri poterant.

source: He hesitated for a moment, but in the end, Sam decided it wasn’t his job to deal with that, so he turned around, motioning for Lucky to follow him, and began to examine the chalice while leisurely walking and trying to ignore the wails of the damned.
target: Paululum dubitavit, sed tandem Sam constituit non suum officium esse id curare; itaque se vertit, Lucky secuti invitans, et calicem examinandum coepit, dum lente ambulabat et gemitus damnatorum praeterire conabatur.

source: The way back to the city of Ironwood was a little more complicated than his journey from it, as several fights between guilds had broken out over the troll farming spots and he had to make an effort to avoid those or sneak through them.
target: Iter ad urbem Ironwood paulo complicatius fuit quam ab ea profectus, cum plures pugnae inter collegia de agris trollorum cultu ortae essent, atque conari debuisset eos vitare aut subreptitius transire.

source: Thankfully, he was lucky enough that nobody spotted him, or if they spotted him, they realized he wasn’t part of the fighting guilds and let him go.
target: Gratias agens, felix fuit quod nemo eum deprehendit, aut si deprehenderunt, cognouerunt eum non esse partem collegiorum bellatorum, atque eum liberaverunt.

source: Just to be sure, he did the entire journey in disguise using his nifty little chameleon mask.
target: Certo scitu, totum iter sub persona furti egit, utens parva larva chameleonis ingeniosa.

source: He arrived back at the city gates, exhausted but triumphant.
target: Rediit ad portas urbis, exhaustus sed triumphans.

source: Ignoring the small beggar child with too white and too many teeth giving him a thumbs up near the road leading to the gates, he checked his clothing and armor and headed towards the old ranger’s house.
target: Neglecto parvo puero mendico, nimis candidus et multos dentes habens, qui prope viam ad portas pollicem tribuens, vestimenta et armaturam inspiciens, versus domum veteris ranger se contulit.

source: He had a quest to complete.
target: Habebat propositum ad exsequendum.
